description.value:
Trigger An ally in range dies

Traits Signal, auditory, emotion, mental, fortune

Every other ally in range immediately gains one Standing Reroll, as though from your Crescendo, lasting 1 minute. An ally can hold only one Standing Reroll at a time; an ally who already has one does not gain a second, and the duration does not refresh. This triggers on death, not on being reduced to 0 Hit Points or on being dying.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB2 (Standing Reroll = a reroll grant) and bucket 4 (one creature's death triggering a benefit on unrelated third parties, sourced from the holder's own passive). No Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in Foundry's pf2e system (confirmed: zero hits for "key": "Reroll" in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/, and the full 34-entry rule-element key list has no reroll key -- RollTwice is a different, pre-result advantage/disadvantage mechanic). Encore's core primitive, "spend 1 Encore to reroll a failed check," is a post-result reroll and is categorically unbuildable as a standing rule element.
